author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: These parsers read NordPass Enterprise activity logs from the Activity Logs API. The example bridge in bridges/nordpass-activity-logs pulls the activities and posts them to HTTP Ingest. Sign-ins and master password checks that unlock the vault go to Auth, and every other activity goes to CloudAudit.
notes:
Setup:
- NordPass Enterprise offers its activity log to other tools only through the Activity Logs API, so these parsers read activities pulled by the example bridge in bridges/nordpass-activity-logs and posted to HTTP Ingest with "nordpass_record": "activity" first.
- Owners and Admins create the token under Integrations > Events reporting > Custom in the Admin Panel.

Field mapping:
- Sign-ins (type login) and master password checks that unlock the vault (type lock: master_validated, master_failed, with logon type UNLOCK) go to Auth.
- Every other activity goes to CloudAudit with the action as the event name and the type as the event type: item access, sharing, deletion and the sharing hub are data events, and views, copies, autofills, reveals and exports are read-only.
- The first two items an activity names become resources.
- Only sign-ins carry an IP address.

Sources and licenses:
- NordPass documents the record fields but not their values: the action names, the Unix-seconds timestamp and the metadata shapes (ip_address and provider on sign-ins, platform, items, users, status) come from the sample data and workbook in Microsoft Sentinel's NordPass solution.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples follow those shapes with made-up values, tagged the way the bridge tags them.

Testing:
- Each child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-14 (133 of 133 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs), and the parent's confirm string picked the same records there.
- Each child also passed Run Test as a separate parser under its parent (133 of 133 fields, each line taken in 5 of 5 runs).
- No built-in parser claimed these records.
